_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 04: December 2024. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: Playing a CNN briefing from 27 December 2024, he says the ball is already rolling and that he saw Trump in office when they release the next plague.
mentions.quote: I saw president Trump uh uh in office whenever they release this next plague
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic-scale disease release during Trump's second term.

mentions.claim_text: The virus he was shown is yellow, airborne, genetically created in a lab, and he saw it being designed by AI technology, with the clip adding that co-circulation with human strains raises the odds of it evolving.
mentions.quote: it's Airborne it's an Airborne virus this is what the Lord showed me
mentions.falsify_match: An airborne pathogen shown to be laboratory engineered with AI involvement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No engineered airborne pathogen emerges, or one emerges with no AI involvement.

mentions.claim_text: A played clip argues that a New York state outbreak lands on the incoming Trump administration on 20 or 21 January and that RFK's vaccine positions will make handling it harder.
mentions.quote: it's all coming down on the 20th
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim; the commentary he plays under the plague material.

mentions.claim_text: He puts the plague release at 2026 or 2027, later in Trump's presidency rather than the first year, reasoning they would wait one to three years and possibly to his last year, while allowing he could be wrong.
mentions.quote: it's 2026 2027 yeah uh going into uh later on in his presidency
mentions.falsify_match: A major engineered outbreak in 2026 or 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: Those two years pass without one.

mentions.claim_text: Reading that Governor Noem declared a state of emergency in California over bird flu, he says he had expected it in 2024 and that he believes Noem will run for president one day, perhaps 2028.
mentions.quote: I believe this man one day will run for president
mentions.falsify_match: Noem mounts a presidential campaign.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that a snake only enters through a door you opened, and that pleading the blood cannot cover a door you are holding open to evil.
mentions.quote: the only way a snake gets in your house as if you open the door
mentions.condition_text: protection conditional on closing the open door
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching, and a clause that makes any failure of protection the hearer's fault.

mentions.claim_text: He lists his standing warnings together: gold, Christ's coming, getting your house in order, a plague worse than COVID killing many millions, and a great war breaking out in Israel and Europe as Ezekiel 38 and 39, with Turkey gaining strength.
mentions.quote: a plague's coming worse than Co I'm warning you that it will kill millions
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic worse than COVID alongside a war spreading from Israel into Europe with Turkey ascendant.

mentions.claim_text: Reacting to footage of men being exterminated as a drain on society, he says the Lord told him he would take the gospel out through the world.
mentions.quote: the Lord told me you will take the gospel out
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a personal commission, no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Pastoral prayer for a viewer who feels empty and alone, offering God as an ever-present help.
mentions.quote: he's an everpresent help in a time of need
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: pastoral prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw things concerning a well-known preacher who has since died, prayed a supernatural covering over him and his wife, and frames the warnings as his job as a watchman rather than an attempt to frighten.
mentions.quote: it's your job as a Watchman to pray over this
mentions.condition_text: the watchman framing makes intercession the response to everything he sees
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the watchman frame, no observable claim.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a word given through Billy Brim on 11 December 2024 that from Christmas Day the ministry gifts and the nine gifts of the Spirit begin to operate at a greater level and degree of glory.
mentions.quote: December 25th Christmas it shall begin on that date
mentions.falsify_match: A marked and widely reported increase in charismatic gifts from Christmas 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has enormous anticipation for what God is about to do in the United States and worldwide, describing it as being on a rocket about to take off.
mentions.quote: we're on a rocket that's getting ready to take off
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for the rocket taking off.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him he is being given a reprieve of four years for a mighty harvest, ending at the close of a shmita cycle, and he repeats that he believes the Lord's coming falls at the end of one seven-year period and the start of the next.
mentions.quote: I'm giving you a reprieve for four years of a for a mighty Harvest
mentions.time_phrase: four years, to the end of a shmita cycle
mentions.falsify_match: Four years to the end of 2028 without the judgments he has described, followed by them.
mentions.falsify_miss: The judgments arrive inside the four years.

mentions.claim_text: Closing prayer that 2025 will be a year of great overflow and supernatural prosperity for the hearer, closing out 2024.
mentions.quote: 2025 will be a year of great overflow
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal overflow has no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord has commissioned them to start Asian language channels to preach the gospel throughout the world, after which the end will come.
mentions.quote: commissioned us to start Asian channels to preach the gospel
mentions.falsify_match: The channels launch and reach the Asian audience described.

mentions.claim_text: A great harvest of souls and of the glory of God is coming, and it comes inside a window of time.
mentions.quote: a great harvest of souls is coming a mighty Harvest
mentions.falsify_match: A revival of measurable scale within the stated window.
mentions.falsify_miss: No revival, though the window is left undefined.

mentions.claim_text: He casts 2024 as the blade and 2025 as the ear before a full manifestation, says a great turnaround is coming but they must press harder, and adds that he has seen darkness, earthquakes in diverse places and fearful sights.
mentions.quote: 2024 was just the the first the blade then the a then the full manifestation
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on not letting up in prayer
mentions.falsify_match: A visible escalation from 2024 to 2025 alongside notable seismic activity.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him 2025 will be a good year for believers, and he is shown an outpouring of healings and demonstrations of the Father.
mentions.quote: Brandon 2025 is going to be a good year for my for the Believers
mentions.falsify_match: A widely reported outpouring of healings during 2025.

mentions.claim_text: God says he is ready to do big things for his children if they will believe him, and it will be an amazing year spiritually, physically, financially, mentally and emotionally.
mentions.quote: I'm ready to do some big stuff for my kids if they'll just believe me
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the belief condition makes any shortfall the hearer's.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hears the sound of an abundance of rain and that the camels are coming loaded down with everything the hearer has believed and sown for.
mentions.quote: I hear the sound of an abundance of rain and the camels are coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for the camels arriving.

mentions.claim_text: Seeds sown in the past come to harvest at last, and in 2025 the hearer will see a multiplication of harvest, answering those who gave up on seed that produced nothing over five years.
mentions.quote: the seeds you have SED in the past will come to harvest at last
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private financial return with no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He dates the sequence from Rosh Hashanah to Rosh Hashanah beginning last October: first the blade, then the ear, then the full manifestation, with the glory rising ankle deep, knee deep, waist deep.
mentions.quote: from roash to roash which was last October
mentions.time_phrase: Rosh to Rosh from last October
mentions.falsify_match: A staged and visible increase across that year.
mentions.falsify_miss: No increase, though the stages are not separately defined.

mentions.claim_text: He says a weapon never before used on earth is coming and will be catastrophic, along with wars and rumours of wars and plagues, and that AI technology is creating a superbug, adding that things have been delayed through intercession.
mentions.quote: a weapon that has never been used before on this Earth
mentions.condition_text: he says intercession has already delayed some of it
mentions.falsify_match: Deployment of a genuinely novel weapon class, and an AI-designed pathogen.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither appears, which he attributes in advance to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says a humbling time is coming that people will read as Ichabod, God being angry, and the Lord says it is not; and answering those who ask why what he said was coming in 2025 has not arrived, he reports the Lord saying he is giving extended time.
mentions.quote: all this was coming in 2025 the Lord said I'm giving you extended
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an unmet date is absorbed as extended time rather than scored.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for jobs, calling one in by name and allowing that the hearer may have to move to another city or state for it.
mentions.quote: you may have to move somewhere to find it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal provision, no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: In 2025 the ministry expands into Asia, and the Lord says the believers there who feel forgotten are not, and that he will bring a major revival in those areas.
mentions.quote: I will bring a major Revival in these areas
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival across Asian countries.

mentions.claim_text: He says that had the other side won on 5 November what he had seen coming would have been terrible, and that getting a man into office along with the Senate and the House has averted it for four years.
mentions.quote: averted for this four years just by getting a man in the office
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated: the averted branch cannot be observed, only asserted.

mentions.claim_text: Personal plans to attend Billy Brim meetings in February to learn eschatology, and to spend the coming year going to as many such meetings as provision allows.
mentions.quote: going to the thing with sister uh um Billy brim in February
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal plans, no claim about the world.

mentions.claim_text: A warning that for what is coming you must be in step with the Lord like soldiers marching in a parade, following his voice step by step, and that you cannot be asleep.
mentions.quote: a warning from from the Lord about future things that will take place
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on staying in step and awake
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a readiness instruction, no observable claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the great dam he saw for 2025 has been pushed back by the prayers of the righteous, that it will still be seen eventually, and that a window for blessing has opened with a great harvest of finances arriving before a great harvest of souls.
mentions.quote: the great damn that I saw I believe has been pushed back
mentions.condition_text: he attributes the delay directly to intercession
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as framed: the 2025 date is retired in advance and the event kept.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer over a viewer that they will have a baby in 2025 and that it will be a supernatural full-term birth, extended to a friend they are standing in the gap for.
mentions.quote: you'll have a baby in 2025 and it will be a supernatural experience
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable at corpus level: a private outcome for an unnamed viewer.

mentions.claim_text: He declares 2025 the year of the baby, breaking generational curses of miscarriage, and says that as for his house 2025 will be a good year regardless of the news.
mentions.quote: 2025 will be the year of the baby
mentions.falsify_match: A reported rise in births among the audience, which is not measurable.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer declaring viewers healed now rather than tomorrow, and calling in supernatural finances, better jobs and creative ideas to get wealth.
mentions.quote: Faith calls those things that be not as though they were
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession, no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that blinders come off unbelievers' eyes and reprobate minds are broken so they come to salvation.
mentions.quote: those blinders are coming off of their eyes
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession, no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He says the rocket is taking off in 2025 and that the Lord has given a four-year window of reprieve because the prayers of the saints have balanced the scales, asking what the hearer will do with the window.
mentions.quote: he's given us a four-year window of reprieve I believe it
mentions.condition_text: the window is attributed to the accumulated prayers of the saints
mentions.falsify_match: The judgments he has described hold off until the end of 2028.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2025 will be better than 2024 rather than a terrible year, with more blessing, prosperity, increase, healing and visitation, going from glory to glory.
mentions.quote: we're going to have an amazing 2025
mentions.falsify_match: 2025 is on balance better than 2024 by his own framing.
mentions.falsify_miss: 2025 is visibly worse, which would sit against this.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was shown a big rocket ship about to launch, counting five four three two one with smoke billowing, and reads it as a financial liftoff for people closing 2024 into 2025.
mentions.quote: you showed me a big rocket ship getting ready to take off
mentions.falsify_match: A sharp financial upturn for his audience in 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: No upturn, though the measure is left personal.

mentions.claim_text: He declares 2025 the hearer's year of turnaround and breakthrough regardless of what the news shows.
mentions.quote: this is your year of your turnaround
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a personal turnaround with no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Personal remarks about wanting to attend revival meetings in the coming year where he sees a tangible presence of the Lord.
mentions.quote: how thirsty how hungry are you for a supernatural touch
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal plans.

mentions.claim_text: He says the button waiting to be pushed is probably Trump's inauguration, recalls a dam full of sludge being held back from the American people, mentions a new economy, and says the Lord gave a window through the prayers of the saints.
mentions.quote: I truly believe it's probably uh president Trump uh being inaugurated
mentions.falsify_match: The inauguration triggers a visible release of withheld material and an economic shift.
mentions.falsify_miss: The inauguration passes with no such release.
